## 类型 / Type

- [ ] 事实校正或断链 / Factual correction or broken link（下方附来源 URL / source URL below）
- [ ] 面试题或 JD / Interview question or job description
- [ ] 仓库表面（README、模板、Pages）/ Repo surface (README, templates, Pages)
- [ ] 网页阅读体验 / Reading experience on the HTML pages
- [ ] 英文平行稿 / English parallel (`*.en.md` / `*.en.html`)

## 核对 / Check

- [ ] 没有整章重写无关长文 / No unrelated full-chapter rewrite
- [ ] 新增或改动的事实有一手来源 URL / New or changed facts have a primary-source URL
- [ ] 若改了 `.md` 正文，对应 `html/` 已同步 / Matching `html/` updated if Markdown substance changed
- [ ] 若改了中文或英文一边的实质内容，另一语言的平行文件也已同步 / The other language was updated too
- [ ] `overview.md` 与 `run_manifest.json` 未被顺手「对齐」/ `overview.md` and `run_manifest.json` were not casually reconciled
